entities.name: 持久化执行 (durable execution)
entities.how_described: 本集称之为业界叫法,指把每一步记进事件日志,进程崩溃后能从失败点精确续跑而不是从头再来;也用于人工审批这类长等待——持久 promise 当挂起点,等待期在无服务器上不占执行时间

evidence.quote: This is called durable execution in the industry.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So that's the idea of durable execution.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so with durable execution you can actually also suspend a function and bring it back when it's able to make progress.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 事件日志 (journal)
entities.how_described: 本集说智能体干活时不断把事件发给 Restate 服务器形成 journal,像智能体的生命线,故障后靠它把执行恢复到失败点

evidence.quote: So as the agent is doing stuff, it sends events over to Restate, and Restate will use that journal of events to recover the process after a failure.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so this journal you see here on the left, that is basically the events that get sent from the agent to the restate server.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And if this now crashes at some point, this journal is what will be used to recover the execution to the point where it failed.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So instead of starting over, it uses the journal to recover the progress.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So in the case of a human approval what we do here is basically we create a durable promise which lives in that journal a bit like a suspension point.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So inside the box you basically on one side have the clients, on the other side the services, and inside the box is a log which persists all those journal events and an event loop.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
